title: Information-Guided Frontier Decoding: Contextual Utility-Driven Commitment in dMLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decoding quality in diffusion multimodal language models (dMLLMs) depends heavily on the order in which masked tokens are committed. Existing confidence-based strategies prioritize locally easy tokens, but confidence does not necessarily reflect contextual usefulness. As a result, structurally easy tokens such as punctuation may be committed before informative semantic anchors, weakening context propagation and increasing error accumulation. We propose Information-Guided Frontier Decoding (IGFD), a training-free decoding strategy that ranks candidates using token confidence, neighborhood uncertainty, and structural commitment risk. IGFD encourages early commitment of reliable semantic anchors while delaying fragile structural tokens, improving contextual support during decoding. translated_title: 信息引导的前沿解码：扩散多模态语言模型中的上下文效用驱动承诺
translated_abstract: 扩散多模态语言模型（dMLLMs）的解码质量在很大程度上取决于掩码令牌被承诺的顺序。现有的基于置信度的策略优先处理局部简单的令牌，但置信度并不一定反映上下文的有用性。因此，结构上简单的令牌（如标点符号）可能在信息丰富的语义锚点之前被承诺，从而削弱上下文传播并增加错误累积。我们提出了信息引导的前沿解码（IGFD），这是一种无需训练的解码策略，它使用令牌置信度、邻域不确定性和结构承诺风险对候选进行排名。IGFD鼓励在解码过程中尽早承诺可靠的语义锚点，同时延迟脆弱的结构令牌，从而改善上下文支持。动态候选前沿进一步将令牌选择限制在相同解码预算下的局部可扩展区域内。该方法无需额外训练，仅需少量计算开销。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的解码策略IGFD，通过结合置信度、邻域不确定性和结构风险来优化令牌承诺顺序，优先保留语义锚点并延迟结构脆弱令牌，从而提升扩散多模态语言模型的解码质量。
en_tdlr: IGFD is a training-free decoding strategy that ranks tokens by confidence, neighborhood uncertainty, and structural risk to prioritize semantic anchors over fragile tokens, improving decoding quality in diffusion multimodal language models.
